question: Which of the following is an organic compound with the formula CH₃OC₆H₅ used as a perfume, fragrance and solvent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anisole.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Methoxybenzene** is often known as** anisole.**
 
• It is a chemical substance with the formula **CH₃OC₆H₅.**
 
• It is a **white liquid **with an** anise-seed aroma.**
 
• Both** natural and synthetic scents **frequently contain its derivatives.
 
• It is employed in the production of various compounds as well as the** flavoring of food and perfumes.**
 
• Because** DOT and NFPA** have noted anisole, it is listed on the **Hazardous Substance List.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Toluene:**

 
 
• A substituted** aromatic hydrocarbon** is toluene.
 
• It is a** colorless, insoluble in water liquid** with a paint thinner-like odor.
 
 
 
• **Acetophenone:**
 
 
• The **simplest aromatic ketone** is acetophenone.
 
• This **clear, thick liquid serves** as a base for helpful resins and scents.
 
 
 
• **Aniline:**
 
 
• An organic **chemical substance** called aniline is a** main aromatic amine.**
 
• It is made up of an **amino group and a benzene ring. **
